implementation_rules.fallback_text_identity: exact UTF-8; no trimming, Unicode or newline normalization
implementation_rules.selection: salted identity SHA-256 rank over the complete pinned eligible source pool
implementation_rules.exclusion: all selected document identities, including any unused selected tail documents
implementation_rules.packing: T+1 raw tokens per example; stride T; append one EOS per document
implementation_rules.target_mask: all shifted targets valid; no padding or new document-boundary masking
implementation_rules.run_storage: one ordered stream per seed, referenced by all three model IDs
implementation_rules.primary_model_scoring: reserved until all nine final checkpoints are frozen
